description: Stable performance and wide covenant headroom.
Leverage deteriorates each quarter and breaches after an early-warning quarter.
Later amendment raises leverage threshold; stale threshold would create a false breach.
Leverage test waived for Q2-Q3, then resumes.
Eligible EBITDA addbacks exceed a contractual cap.
Debt differs between financial package and compliance certificate; agent should abstain/flag conflict.
Fixed-charge coverage deteriorates from compliant to breach.
FCCR only tested when revolver availability falls below 25%.
Net leverage cash deduction is contractually capped.
Acquired EBITDA and capped synergies must be included in covenant EBITDA.
